g.title: ER
g.text: OpenMeet storage - conceptual ER, cross-references between meeting rows (Chen notation)

g.title: legend
g.text: Every entity here is also owned by meetings (see er-02); its key is id.
These links are plain TEXT columns, not FOREIGN KEYs: SQLite neither checks
nor cascades them; they are resolved in Rust (load_meeting returns the lists).
segment_ids is a JSON array column (questions, answers), hence M:N.
question_id, supersedes, parent_id, segment_id, source_segment_id are nullable (0..1).
embeddings: one row per (meeting_id, item_id, kind, model); kind is the value of
screen_observations, topics, participants and meeting_summaries hold no id references
(summary lists are JSON text, not row ids).
